# Linkdrop

Linkdrop is a web tool for creating short links and WhatsApp links, sharing QR codes, and reviewing click analytics for links owned by the signed-in user.

## Primary page

- [Linkdrop](https://linkdrop.raztom.com/): Create and manage short links and WhatsApp links.

## Related tool

- [QR-It](https://qr-it.raztom.com/): Generate QR codes for links.
